newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian peso ends slightly lower vs dollar.
newsitem.headline: Colombian peso ends slightly lower vs dollar.

text.p: Colombia's peso edged down a slight 0.1 pesos against the dollar to close at 1,062 in nervous trading on the country's interbank market.

Dealers said market jitters were fueled by an imminent Constitutional Court ruling on the legality of emergency economic measures unveiled by the government nearly two months ago. The measures include a tax on all new foreign loans designed to curb the surge in foreign capital that pushed the peso to artifically high trading levels late last year.
Dealers reported 381 trades for a total of $155 million and said the peso held in a 1,060.30 to 1,065.60 range.
